items.html: Arsalan Qadir had an outstanding campaign at the 2010 Under-19 World Cup Qualifiers, taking 14 wickets. The Peshawar-born right-arm fast bowler was also part of Canada's squad for the 2010 Under-19 World Cup. Andrew Flintoff is his hero.
